CONVENTIONAL.name: Conventional Tillage
CONVENTIONAL.description: Full inversion with the plough, followed by secondary tillage.

MINIMUM_TILL.name: Minimum Till
MINIMUM_TILL.description: Loosening without inversion; residues stay near the surface.

discouragedWork.PLOWING: Ploughing inverts the soil and cancels the benefits of Minimum Till.

STRIP_TILL.name: Strip Till
STRIP_TILL.description: Only the seed row strips are tilled and fertilised.

discouragedWork.PLOWING: Ploughing destroys the untilled strips between rows.
discouragedWork.DISCING: Full-width discing works the strips that Strip Till keeps covered.

NO_TILL.name: No Till
NO_TILL.description: Direct sowing into the residue of the previous crop.

discouragedWork.PLOWING: No Till does not plough. Ploughing breaks the soil structure built up over years.
discouragedWork.DISCING: No Till does not disc. Discing buries the residue that protects the soil.
discouragedWork.SUBSOILING: No Till does not loosen the soil before sowing.

discouragedTasks.SOIL_PREP: No Till skips seedbed preparation; sow directly into the residue.
